origin: Redacted model-visible regression extracted from immutable development trace; branch links reconnected after removing non-tool entries

findings.claim: core.py:encode was changed from encode(value) to encode(value, format) with no default. Untouched callers adapter.py:serialize and api.py:response still call it with a single positional argument, so every call now raises TypeError: encode() missing 1 required positional argument: 'format'.
findings.impact: Serialization path api.response → adapter.serialize → core.encode is broken at runtime for all values, changing behavior from returning str(value) to raising an exception.
findings.title: encode() now requires a new 'format' argument, breaking all existing callers with TypeError
findings.trigger: Call api.response(value) or adapter.serialize(value) after this change.
